lastNDays.title: Filed in the last (days)
lastNDays.description: Only filings from the last N calendar days, including today (UTC). Ignored when "Filed on or after" is set. EDGAR accepts filings on business days only, so use at least 4 to always cover two business days.

startDate.title: Filed on or after
startDate.description: Start of the filing-date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides "Filed in the last (days)".

endDate.title: Filed on or before
endDate.description: End of the filing-date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

states.title: Issuer states
states.description: Two-letter codes of the issuer's business address state, e.g. CA, NY, TX. Leave empty for all states and countries.

industryGroups.title: Industry groups
industryGroups.description: Form D industry groups to include. A category such as Technology (all) includes all its groups. Leave empty for all industries.

enumTitles: Banking & Financial Services: Pooled Investment Fund

excludeInvestmentFunds.title: Exclude investment funds
excludeInvestmentFunds.description: Skip pooled investment funds (hedge, private equity, VC funds and SPVs), which file over half of all Form Ds. Keeps operating companies such as startups.

minOfferingAmount.title: Min total offering amount (USD)
minOfferingAmount.description: Only offerings of at least this size. Offerings marked "Indefinite" count as unlimited.

maxOfferingAmount.title: Max total offering amount (USD)
maxOfferingAmount.description: Only offerings of at most this size. Excludes "Indefinite" offerings.

filingType.title: Filing type
filingType.description: New notices (Form D), amendments (Form D/A, e.g. updated amounts sold) or both.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of filings to return. Each filing is billed as one event.

onlyNew.title: Only new filings (delta mode)
onlyNew.description: Skip filings already returned by earlier runs with the same filters (dates excluded). Ideal for scheduled daily runs.
